:::{#exm-score-bernoulli}
#### Score of one Bernoulli observation

For a Bernoulli variable with event probability $\prob$ and observed value $x \in \cb{0, 1}$,
the [score](#def-score) is $(x - \prob) / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$,
derived in [the Bernoulli score](bernoulli-mle.qmd#thm-bernoulli-score).
:::
